switches.name: --allow-unmeasured-memory
switches.purpose: Allow subagent context above the measured token limit.
switches.note: Keep it off unless the required context exceeds the measured memory limit.

switches.name: --api-key
switches.purpose: Require an API key from clients.
switches.note: Set a key when clients must authenticate to the server.

switches.name: --cache-disk
switches.purpose: Set the disk prompt cache directory.
switches.note: Set a directory when prompt snapshots must persist across server restarts.

switches.name: --cache-disk-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit disk prompt cache storage.
switches.note: Keep 8 GiB unless the disk cache must retain more prompt snapshots.

switches.name: --cache-disk-staging-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit RAM used to stage disk prompt snapshots.
switches.note: Keep automatic sizing unless disk persistence needs a different RAM limit.

switches.name: --cache-ram-bytes
switches.purpose: Set the RAM snapshot cache budget.
switches.note: Keep the profile limit unless available host RAM requires a smaller cache.

switches.name: --context
switches.purpose: Set the context token limit for each session.
switches.note: Keep the profile context unless the task requires a different token limit.

switches.name: --debug-hooks
switches.purpose: Control debug hooks.
switches.note: Inventory classification.

switches.name: --dflash-model
switches.purpose: Control dflash model.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.

switches.name: --draft-policy
switches.purpose: Control draft policy.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.

switches.name: --draft-tokens
switches.purpose: Set the maximum speculative draft length.
switches.note: Keep seven tokens unless speculative draft length tests require another value.

switches.name: --dspark-model
switches.purpose: Control dspark model.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.

switches.name: --exact
switches.purpose: Select the exact profile.
switches.note: Enable it when output must repeat with the same build, prompt, and seed.

switches.name: --frequency-penalty
switches.purpose: Penalize tokens by their generated occurrence count.
switches.note: Keep zero unless the task needs fewer frequently repeated tokens.

switches.name: --help
switches.purpose: Control help.
switches.note: unclassified

switches.name: --host
switches.purpose: Set the server listen address.
switches.note: Keep the local address unless remote clients must connect to the server.

switches.name: --log-level
switches.purpose: Set the amount of server log detail.
switches.note: Keep info unless diagnosis requires debug messages or normal operation needs fewer messages.

switches.name: --log-progress
switches.purpose: Log prompt processing progress.
switches.note: Keep it off unless prompt processing progress must appear in the log.

switches.name: --manifest
switches.purpose: Control manifest.
switches.note: unclassified

switches.name: --max-buffered-output-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit buffered output for each request.
switches.note: Keep 64 KiB unless slow clients require more buffered output per request.

switches.name: --max-buffered-output-total
switches.purpose: Limit buffered output across all requests.
switches.note: Keep 256 KiB unless concurrent slow clients require more total buffered output.

switches.name: --max-connections
switches.purpose: Limit simultaneous HTTP connections.
switches.note: Keep 16 unless the client workload requires more simultaneous HTTP connections.

switches.name: --max-output-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit output text bytes for each request.
switches.note: Keep 1 MiB unless a request must return more output text.

switches.name: --max-pending
switches.purpose: Limit queued requests.
switches.note: Keep 16 unless the workload requires a larger request queue.

switches.name: --max-pending-per-client
switches.purpose: Limit queued requests from each client.
switches.note: Keep the queue limit unless one client must have a smaller request allowance.

switches.name: --max-request-bytes
switches.purpose: Set the maximum HTTP request body size.
switches.note: Keep 64 MiB unless larger request bodies are required.

switches.name: --max-score-tokens
switches.purpose: Control max score tokens.
switches.note: Inventory classification.

switches.name: --max-tokens
switches.purpose: Limit new tokens generated per request.
switches.note: Keep unlimited generation unless responses need a fixed new token limit.

switches.name: --min-draft-tokens
switches.purpose: Set the minimum speculative draft length.
switches.note: Keep one token unless speculative draft tests require a larger minimum.

switches.name: --min-keep
switches.purpose: Retain a minimum number of sampling candidates.
switches.note: Keep zero unless probability filters must retain a minimum number of candidates.

switches.name: --min-p
switches.purpose: Filter tokens by probability relative to the best token.
switches.note: Keep zero unless the task needs minimum probability filtering.

switches.name: --mmproj
switches.purpose: Set the vision sidecar file.
switches.note: Set the matching vision sidecar when the model must process images.

switches.name: --model
switches.purpose: Control model.
switches.note: Inventory classification.

switches.name: --mtp-draft-vocab
switches.purpose: Select the MTP draft head vocabulary.
switches.note: Keep the profile vocabulary unless draft vocabulary tests require another setting.

switches.name: --mtp-model
switches.purpose: Set the MTP sidecar file.
switches.note: Set the matching MTP sidecar when speculative decoding is required.

switches.name: --mtp-policy
switches.purpose: Select the MTP draft length controller.
switches.note: Keep survival unless draft acceptance tests require the length policy.

switches.name: --no-behaviour
switches.purpose: Disable the eight behaviour defaults.
switches.note: Keep policies enabled unless plain sampling is required outside the exact profile.

switches.name: --no-cache
switches.purpose: Disable RAM and disk prompt caches for all requests.
switches.note: Enable it when every request must prefill its full prompt for reproducible output.

switches.name: --no-cache-disk
switches.purpose: Disable the disk snapshot cache.
switches.note: Enable it when the supplied disk cache directory must be ignored.

switches.name: --no-draft-head
switches.purpose: Suppress the manifest draft output head.
switches.note: Enable it when MTP must run without the supplied draft head.

switches.name: --no-mtp
switches.purpose: Disable MTP defaults and the speculative backend.
switches.note: Enable it when decoding must run without MTP.

switches.name: --no-prompt-lookup
switches.purpose: Disable prompt lookup proposals.
switches.note: Keep prompt lookup enabled with MTP unless lookup comparisons require it off.

switches.name: --no-twin
switches.purpose: Suppress the manifest dense twin.
switches.note: Enable it when decoding must run without the supplied dense twin.

switches.name: --no-vision
switches.purpose: Suppress the manifest vision sidecar.
switches.note: Enable it when the server must omit the vision sidecar.

switches.name: --port
switches.purpose: Set the server listen port.
switches.note: Keep 8080 unless another service uses that port or clients require a different port.

switches.name: --prefill-chunk
switches.purpose: Limit prompt tokens between active decode rounds.
switches.note: Keep 512 unless active sessions need shorter pauses during another request prefill.

switches.name: --presence-penalty
switches.purpose: Penalize tokens already generated in the response.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different penalty for previously generated tokens.

switches.name: --preserve-thinking
switches.purpose: Select which thinking history to retain.
switches.note: Keep auto unless the client requires a different policy for retained thinking history.

switches.name: --print-effective-settings
switches.purpose: Print resolved settings as JSON and exit.
switches.note: Enable it when resolved settings must be inspected without loading a model.

switches.name: --profile
switches.purpose: Select the release settings profile.
switches.note: Keep default for normal use, select subagents for concurrency, or select exact for reproducibility.

switches.name: --prompt-lookup
switches.purpose: Propose tokens from an earlier conversation match.
switches.note: Keep it enabled with MTP unless prompt lookup comparisons require it off.

switches.name: --reasoning-effort
switches.purpose: Set the default reasoning effort.
switches.note: Keep medium unless the task requires a different reasoning effort.

switches.name: --repeat-last-n
switches.purpose: Set the recent token window for repetition penalties.
switches.note: Keep 64 unless repetition penalties need a different recent token window.

switches.name: --repeat-penalty
switches.purpose: Penalize recently used tokens.
switches.note: Keep one unless the task needs a penalty for recent repeated tokens.

switches.name: --request-timeout-ms
switches.purpose: Limit request time in milliseconds.
switches.note: Keep zero unless requests must stop after a fixed time limit.

switches.name: --root
switches.purpose: Control root.
switches.note: unclassified

switches.name: --seed
switches.purpose: Set the random sampling seed.
switches.note: Use a nonnegative seed for reproducibility; exact uses one unless another nonnegative seed is supplied.

switches.name: --served-model-name
switches.purpose: Set the model identifier exposed by the API.
switches.note: Set a name when clients require a model identifier different from the model file name.

switches.name: --sessions
switches.purpose: Set the number of preallocated request sessions.
switches.note: Keep one for exact output or select subagents when four requests must run concurrently.

switches.name: --speculative
switches.purpose: Select the speculative draft backend.
switches.default_text: mtp with an MTP sidecar; otherwise off
switches.note: Keep MTP with its sidecar or select off when plain autoregressive decoding is required.

switches.name: --temperature
switches.purpose: Set the randomness of token sampling.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs different randomness or greedy decoding with zero.

switches.name: --think
switches.purpose: Set the default reasoning mode.
switches.note: Keep on unless the task does not need reasoning.

switches.name: --top-k
switches.purpose: Limit sampling to the highest probability candidates.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different sampling candidate limit.

switches.name: --top-p
switches.purpose: Filter sampling candidates by cumulative probability.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different cumulative probability limit.

switches.name: --trace
switches.purpose: Write request and generation content to a JSONL file.
switches.note: The trace file contains client content.

switches.name: --ttl
switches.purpose: Control ttl.
switches.note: unclassified

switches.name: --verbose
switches.purpose: Control verbose.
switches.note: unclassified

switches.name: --voice
switches.purpose: Control voice.
switches.note: unclassified
